description: This file contains the implementation of the TriggerCentral class and associated functions for handling engine trigger signals and events, including noise filtering, event dispatching, and configuration management. It manages trigger input signals, filters interference, tracks trigger event states, and notifies registered listeners.

classes.name: TriggerCentral
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing trigger input signals, filtering noise, tracking trigger state, and dispatching events to registered listeners.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::resetAccumSignalData
methods.description: Resets internal signal timing and period accumulators to initial values.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::getHwEventCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of hardware events of a specific type.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::addEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback listener for trigger events.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::noiseFilter
methods.description: Filters out noise spikes based on accumulated signal periods, allowing only valid trigger edges.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::handleShaftSignal
methods.description: Processes incoming trigger shaft signals, filters noise if enabled, updates trigger state, and notifies listeners.
